tasks.discoverability: The empty dashboard's "New project" button was the first thing I saw; it opened the navigation drawer with a focused name field rather than a form in place, which surprised me but worked.

steps.expect: Tapping New project opens a name form.
steps.observed: The navigation drawer slid in with an inline Project name field, already focused, and Create.

steps.expect: Typing a name and tapping Create opens the new project.
steps.observed: Opened /projects/… titled Garden plan, empty canvas with Add a section; header Undo offers "Created Garden plan". A Flow layout card tells me to press Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+D.

tasks.verification: Page title "Garden plan · Canvas Work Manager" and h1 Garden plan; Undo names the creation.

tasks.discoverability: I opened Menu expecting an add control by Kitchen in the tree; there was none, and I only found Add workstream by trying the pencil icon at the top of the drawer.

steps.expect: Menu shows projects including Kitchen.
steps.observed: Only "Home renovation" is listed at top level.

steps.expect: Opening Home renovation shows its workstreams.
steps.action: tap Home renovation in the drawer
steps.observed: The project opened and the drawer closed; the page shows no workstreams.

steps.expect: The drawer now shows Kitchen with an add option.
steps.observed: Tree shows pages, Kitchen (with a chevron) and Garden; no add control except a pencil icon.

steps.expect: Kitchen opens.
steps.observed: Kitchen opened; tree unchanged.

steps.expect: The pencil edits something; maybe it has an add.
steps.observed: Menu: "Pages of Home renovation…", "Add workstream".

steps.expect: A dialog with Kitchen as parent.
steps.observed: Dialog with Name (focused) and Parent defaulting to Kitchen, "Inside Kitchen".

steps.expect: The workstream is created under Kitchen.
steps.observed: Lighting opened, breadcrumb Home renovation › Kitchen › Lighting (wrapping awkwardly), toast "Created Lighting under Kitchen." with Undo.

tasks.verification: Breadcrumb shows Kitchen as parent; toast "Created Lighting under Kitchen."

tasks.discoverability: Kitchen's first screen had no labelled way to add a section; I tried the header's More menu first, then guessed that the faint "+" between sections adds one.

steps.expect: Kitchen opens from the dashboard.
steps.observed: Kitchen canvas with Markdown, Task List, Progress, Reflections, Timeline, Recent Activity.

steps.expect: More holds "Add section".
steps.observed: Edit details, Status, Open archive, Pages, Add workstream, Archive workstream; no section creation.

steps.expect: The small + adds something here.
steps.action: tap outside to close; tap the "+" between Markdown and Task List
steps.observed: Dialog "Add a section" with Section type and Name.

steps.expect: A Task List named Pantry appears.
steps.action: pick Task List in the native picker; tap Name; type "Pantry"; tap Create
steps.observed: Pantry section appeared and its heading took focus.

steps.expect: Tasks are added and the field stays ready.
steps.action: tap Task title; type "Buy shelf liners"; tap Add task; tap Task title again; type "Label the jars"; tap Add task
steps.observed: Both tasks added ("2 tasks"); after each add, focus stayed on the button so I had to tap the field again.

steps.expect: Both tasks show as done.
steps.observed: Both struck through, "Done Completed 2026-08-24".

tasks.verification: Pantry's accessibility tree shows both checkboxes "Reopen task …" [checked].

tasks.discoverability: The dashboard's Today widget lists overdue tasks first; tapping one took me to its list (not to the task), and tapping the title opened a drawer with a date field.

steps.expect: Tapping the overdue task shows it.
steps.action: tap "Review rejected rows" on the dashboard
steps.observed: Client migration opened scrolled to the Task List; the task was off screen and not marked.

steps.expect: Tapping the title opens details.
steps.observed: Full-screen drawer: Title, Priority "medium", Due date 08/20/2026, Status "todo · Overdue", Project "project-client-migration".

steps.expect: Choosing a new date saves.
steps.observed: "Due date saved."; Overdue disappeared from status.

steps.expect: The row shows the new date.
steps.observed: Row reads "Due 2026-08-31".

tasks.verification: Row text "Review rejected rows / Due 2026-08-31" with no Overdue mark.

tasks.discoverability: Sections carry four unlabeled icons; I guessed the boxed x was remove. Bringing it back was the toast's Undo.

steps.expect: One of the icons removes the section.
steps.action: tap the boxed-x icon on Progress
steps.observed: Progress vanished at once (no confirmation); toast "Removed the Progress section." with Undo and Dismiss, which stayed for over 30 s.

steps.expect: Undo brings it back in place.
steps.observed: Progress returned in its place, its heading focused; toast "Undone: Removed the Progress section."

steps.expect: Activity names the removed section.
steps.action: scroll to Recent Activity (after also removing Timeline to time the toast)
steps.observed: Lines read "Section removed “Kitchen”", not the section name.

tasks.verification: Progress region present again in the canvas (count 1) after Undo.

tasks.discoverability: The Markdown section has a visible Edit button under its text.

steps.expect: Edit opens a text editor.
steps.action: tap Kitchen on the dashboard; tap Edit in Markdown
steps.observed: Textarea with the source, focused with caret at the end; Preview, Save, Cancel.

steps.expect: Saving shows the new text.
steps.action: tap into the text; type " Order handles too."; tap Save
steps.observed: Rendered text "Appliances and finishes before cabinets are ordered. Order handles too." with Edit again.

tasks.verification: Markdown region paragraph contains the appended sentence after save.

tasks.discoverability: Having learned the "+" in T03, I opened it and found "Add shortcut" in the corner of the Add a section dialog.

steps.expect: The add dialog offers shortcuts.
steps.action: tap Kitchen; tap the "+" before Markdown; tap Add shortcut
steps.observed: Picker grouped by place: "Home renovation · Home", "Home renovation · Reflections", "Home renovation / Garden · Work canvas", each section with Add and Preview.

steps.expect: Garden's notes appear on Kitchen as a shortcut.
steps.observed: "Markdown (Garden)" appeared first on Kitchen, read-only, with its origin and Open source.

tasks.discoverability: I knew from T02 the pencil held "Pages of Home renovation…"; a fresh user would not expect page visibility behind an edit icon.

steps.expect: Pages lists the pages with toggles.
steps.action: tap Menu; Home renovation; Menu; pencil; Pages of Home renovation…
steps.observed: Popover with checkboxes Home (Required), Todos, Archive, Reflections; the drawer closed.

steps.expect: Unticking hides Reflections with some sign.
steps.observed: Unticked; no confirmation and the navigation is not visible.

steps.expect: Reflections is gone from the tree.
steps.observed: Tree shows Todos and Archive only.

steps.expect: Ticking it brings it back.
steps.action: tap pencil; Pages…; tap Reflections checkbox
steps.observed: Ticked; header Undo reads "Enabled the reflections page"; tree shows Reflections again.

tasks.verification: After closing the popover and reopening Menu, the tree lists Reflections under Home renovation again.

tasks.discoverability: The project tree lists an Archive page directly under Home renovation.

steps.expect: Archive lists archived things with Restore.
steps.action: tap Menu; Home renovation; Menu; Archive
steps.observed: 3 items (Legacy attic, Markdown, Old permit copy) each with Restore; on the phone the rows have an empty left column and the "Markdown" name is one letter per line.

steps.expect: The task comes back.
steps.action: tap Restore on Old permit copy
steps.observed: Item left the list (2 items); toast "Restored “Old permit copy” to Home renovation." with Go to it, Undo, Dismiss.

tasks.verification: Toast's Go to it (not counted) opened the Task List where "Old permit copy" is a row again.

steps.observed: Only Settings and three Revoke buttons.

steps.expect: Settings has a connect entry.
steps.observed: AI & Agents, Archived projects, Appearance; nothing to connect.

steps.expect: The avatar opens an account menu.

steps.expect: The development page named in the layout notice has a connect control.
steps.observed: Agent Connection lists the three existing agents with Copy token; says permissions live in Settings; no way to add one.

tasks.verification: Not reached: no surface offers a new connection; I stopped at the development state page.

tasks.discoverability: The Today widget lists overdue tasks as links at the top of the dashboard.

steps.expect: Tapping the task opens it where it lives, shown and marked.
steps.observed: Client migration opened at its Task List heading; the task sat below the fold (y 1036 of 812) with no highlight.

tasks.verification: URL /projects/project-client-migration/pages/home#section-…-tasks; the row "Notify stakeholders" exists in that list after scrolling.
